goal: Build full Linux desktop application: desktop launcher (.desktop), application launcher script (nsclouddrive-app), system menu/desktop integration, and high-res icon packaging
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create scripts/desktop/nsclouddrive.desktop compliant with XDG Desktop Entry Specification.
2. Implement scripts/nsclouddrive-app standalone window application launcher with auto-daemon management, single-instance activation, and dedicated app mode.
3. Add 'app' and 'gui' commands and auto-launch in graphical sessions to src/cli/nsclouddrive.ps1.
4. Update src/web/app.py to serve static assets and brand/provider logos (/assets/logos/*).
5. Update scripts/install-linux.sh to install launchers, desktop entries, desktop shortcuts on ~/Desktop, and hicolor icons.
6. Verify all automated tests pass with exit code 0.

decisions.decision: Use FreeDesktop.org standard .desktop entry with Actions for quick mounting and unmounting.
decisions.rationale: Allows users to launch NS Cloud Drive from system application menus (XFCE, GNOME, KDE) and execute quick actions from desktop context menus.

decisions.decision: Provide dedicated standalone application mode via Chromium --app flag and nsclouddrive-app wrapper.
decisions.rationale: Creates an authentic desktop application window without browser controls or tabs, matching native desktop feel.

decisions.decision: Install desktop shortcut directly to ~/Desktop with executable permissions and GIO trusted metadata.
decisions.rationale: Allows users on XFCE and Ubuntu VNC desktops to double-click the desktop icon directly to open NS Cloud Drive.

reviewFindings.notes: Verified desktop launcher paths, single-instance activation logic, FreeDesktop specification compliance, and 100% test pass rate across 24 desktop app test assertions.
